description: This file defines an unsafe reflection-based implementation for handling slices, including creating, setting, getting, appending, and resizing slices using unsafe pointers and custom slice headers.

classes.name: UnsafeSliceType
classes.description: A type that provides unsafe operations for manipulating slices, including creation, modification, and access.

methods.name: newUnsafeSliceType
methods.description: Creates a new UnsafeSliceType instance based on a given reflect.Type.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets the value of a slice at the specified object.

methods.name: UnsafeSet
methods.description: Sets the slice data directly using unsafe pointers.

methods.name: IsNil
methods.description: Checks if the given object is nil.

methods.name: UnsafeIsNil
methods.description: Checks if the unsafe pointer to a slice is nil.

methods.name: SetNil
methods.description: Sets the slice to nil.

methods.name: UnsafeSetNil
methods.description: Sets the slice header to represent a nil slice.

methods.name: MakeSlice
methods.description: Creates a new slice with specified length and capacity.

methods.name: UnsafeMakeSlice
methods.description: Creates a new slice using unsafe pointers.

methods.name: LengthOf
methods.description: Returns the length of the slice.

methods.name: UnsafeLengthOf
methods.description: Returns the length of the slice from an unsafe pointer.

methods.name: SetIndex
methods.description: Sets an element at a specific index in the slice.

methods.name: UnsafeSetIndex
methods.description: Sets an element at a specific index using unsafe pointers.

methods.name: GetIndex
methods.description: Retrieves an element at a specific index from the slice.

methods.name: UnsafeGetIndex
methods.description: Retrieves an element at a specific index using unsafe pointers.

methods.name: Append
methods.description: Appends an element to the slice.

methods.name: UnsafeAppend
methods.description: Appends an element to the slice using unsafe pointers.

methods.name: Cap
methods.description: Returns the capacity of the slice.

methods.name: UnsafeCap
methods.description: Returns the capacity from an unsafe pointer.

methods.name: Grow
methods.description: Grows the slice to a new length.

methods.name: UnsafeGrow
methods.description: Grows the slice using unsafe pointers.
